claim: In Ti2 Control, each nosepiece address can be set to move the objective to its escape position before that address passes when the nosepiece rotates, and the escape distance used when changing the specimen is also a setting there.
validity_conditions: Read from Nikon Ti2 Control Ver2.90 for Windows, English manual M706 E15 (sha256 5e43517c...): printed page 73 (PDF page 81). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. This manual is for the Ti2 Control software; the archive holds no Ti2-E hardware manual. Bears on nosepiece_write_runs_no_escape (the prior project: a Micro-Manager nosepiece write runs no escape): what the stand does is configured in the stand, and how this one is configured is not recorded here. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
